sources.name: DCDHF-Me2 UFF starting geometry (39 atoms, C18H16N4O)
sources.version: posts/ai-comp-tools-SI.md at repository commit d5eb2a1; SI post published 2025-03
sources.license: Same rights as the rest of this repository; the structure is an Avogadro build by the author, not third-party data
sources.acquisition: Transcribed verbatim from the fenced xyz block in posts/ai-comp-tools-SI.md (39 atoms, Angstrom, following the '#### DCDHF-Me2 Input Structure' heading) into geometry/dcdhf-me2-uff.xyz. The Avogadro comment line recording a UFF energy of 44.1010644 was replaced with a provenance string; coordinates are unchanged. Source file sha256 604a7b5e08bcf69c18d14b4d896ddb2be04092de8ca0bee3a313fafb50c5b153. The committed sha256 above is of the transcribed xyz.
sources.notes: This is a UFF force-field pre-optimized structure exported from Avogadro as input to a subsequent QM optimization, NOT a DFT minimum, and it is used here only as an optimization starting point. run_tddft.py asserts its formula, connectivity, and nitrile bond lengths before use. The original 2025 calculation scripts and outputs did not survive; this geometry is the only recoverable numerical input from that work.

sources.name: Benzene ideal D6h starting geometry (12 atoms, C6H6)
sources.version: generated 2026-08-13 by the command in acquisition
sources.license: Not applicable; constructed from standard bond lengths, no third-party data
sources.acquisition: Constructed analytically rather than downloaded: six carbons on a regular hexagon of circumradius 1.3915 A and six hydrogens radially outward at C-H 1.0800 A, all z = 0, atom order C0-C5 then H6-H11 so H_i is bonded to C_i. No structure-generation toolkit (RDKit, OpenBabel, ASE) is available in this environment, which is why the structure is built from standard geometry rather than generated or retrieved. It is an optimization starting point, not a QM minimum; the B3LYP/def2-SVP optimum is geometry/benzene-def2-svp-opt.xyz.
sources.notes: Benzene is the contrast case: its strongly allowed band is a symmetry-degenerate E1u pair, so one apparent band is two transitions. That claim depends on the ring being regular, which the optimization is checked against -- results/geometry_benzene_def2-svp.json records a C-C bond spread of 1e-05 A at the minimum, projected as the benzene_cc_bond_spread_ang metric. Recomputed here rather than reused from calcs/uvvis-pushpull, whose numbers came from a Psi4 1.11 environment that no longer exists on this machine.
